title: AAPS 2.8.2 in mg/dl but automation isin mmol
body:
I'm still in objectif 10 (1 more day to go). I activated Automation tab. The first rule (low) was already there.
The bug : my settings are in mg/dl but the settings in _low_ were in mmol.
I'll see if things will change when objectif 11 will be activated tomorrow.

comments.body: More info. It is only the **demo** program that is in mmol. If I delete it and create a new one, it is in mg/dl as everywhere in AAPS.
